Move-in

Raised by hand, built to outlast us.

Timber-frame custom homes, cut in our own shop and raised on your land. Scroll to watch one go up, from bare meadow to the first fire in the hearth.

Start your custom buildWatch the build
Weeks 0 to 6

Land and foundation

We walk your land at sunrise before anything is drawn: where the light falls, where water runs, which trees stay. Then footings go below the frost line and the slab is poured.

  • Soil and drainage survey
  • Radiant tubing in the slab
Weeks 7 to 16

The frame goes up

Each bent is cut and test-fitted in our shop, then tilted up on site and pinned with oak pegs. Most clients bring a chair and watch. Raising day tends to become a family story.

  • 8×10 Douglas fir
  • Mortise and tenon joinery
Weeks 17 to 26

Closed in, sheathed tight

Walls and roof are wrapped in taped sheathing, so the frame stays dry from here on. We blower-test the shell before a single wire is run, because air leaks are cheapest to fix now.

  • Blower-door tested
  • Rain-screen ready
Weeks 27 to 48

The inside comes alive

Oak floors go down, one mason lays the chimney from hearth to crown, and the kitchen is built to your cooking. The timbers stay exposed, so the structure is the room's main feature.

  • Wide-plank white oak
  • Local fieldstone
Week 58

Lights on. Keys in hand.

We finish the path and the planting, then walk you through every system ourselves. Fifty-eight weeks after that first sunrise, it's yours.

What we put in the contract.

One fixed price
You approve a line-item price before we break ground. It changes only when you change the design.
One builder, start to finish
Design, timber shop and site crew work under one roof, so you have one person to call.
A photo log every Friday
Every week of the build, you get photos and a plain summary of what happened and what's next.
Frame test-fitted before it ships
Every joint is assembled in the shop first. Surprises on raising day cost everyone.
Ten-year structural warranty
It stays with the house if you sell it, and our number stays the same.
